winning_patterns.action: Double down on husband-wife psychological and emotional friction points.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 15 views.
weak_patterns.action: Move away from abstract, heavy vocabulary poetry and focus on narrative-driven relatable moments.
